findings.title: negative fixtures are label assertions, not executable rejection behavior
evidence: repair_r1/static_validator.py checks fixture expected == reject_fail_closed and selected marker fields
findings.impact: The static receipt proves the fixture metadata and contract shape, but does not prove an evaluator would reject a present placeholder/retry/foreign edge.
findings.required_action: Add an independent fixture evaluator with explicit reject outcomes for all three negative classes and retain its raw/PID/UTC/exit/hash; keep production and authority states typed absent.
